components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; font: 600 .9375rem/1.2 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1b261f; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e6c978, #c8a24c 55%, #b08a35); border: 1px solid #6f5518; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(.95); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd978; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; font: 600 .9375rem/1.2 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd978; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-tab { width: 17rem; display: block; padding: 3px; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #e6c978, #c8a24c 50%, #a98530); border: 1px solid #6f5518; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5), 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-tab:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-tab-label { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; min-height: 2.2rem; padding: .3rem .7rem; background: #fdfdfb; color: #1e2128; border-radius: 1px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); font: 700 .9375rem/1.25 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; } .ds-tab-count { font: 700 .8125rem/1 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #4a505c; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd978; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { width: 18.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fdfdfb; color: #1e2128; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 -1px #eceee9, 0 3px 0 -1px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 10px 16px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; padding: .3rem 1rem 0; min-height: calc(24px + .3rem); font: 700 .9375rem/24px 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9453d; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 1rem .5rem; font: 400 .9375rem/24px 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 23px, #bcd0e6 23px 24px); } .ds-card-body p { margin: 0; } .ds-address { color: #4a505c; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-card-foot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: .35rem .75rem; align-items: center; padding: .55rem 1rem .65rem; border-top: 1px solid #bcd0e6; font: 400 .8125rem/1.3 'Courier Prime', monospace; color: #4a505c; } .ds-list { font: 600 .75rem/1.3 'Archivo Narrow', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; font: 700 .75rem/1.3 'Courier Prime', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #34503f; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-stamp-approx { color: #b3261e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
Saved places are index cards in a library card catalogue, not rows in an export. The page is a catalogue-room green ground with a faint paper grain. Lists are drawers and drawer-front tabs in brass, each place is a white index card with pale-blue ruled lines and a single red line under its title, and everything on a card is set in typewriter type. The tool files the user's data; it does not present an upload widget above a table.

Density is moderate and calm. One brass primary action per area carries all the colour; the rest is green, white card and ink. Depth is physical (paper edges, brass bevels, a drawer lip), never glassy. Motion is small and mechanical: a card files in, a tab slides out, a drawer pull gives a few pixels.
keyCharacteristics: Green ground, white card: the only two large surfaces, with brass as the sole accent.
Typewriter (Courier Prime) for anything that sits on a card or names the thing being filed; Archivo for interface text and controls.
A 24px baseline (--line) shared by the ruled card background and the typed text so type sits on the rules.
Hardware (brass bevels, rivets, drawer pull) for controls; paper for content.
Honesty is rendered as ink: approximate coordinates are the one red thing on a card.

rules.name: The Two-Ground Rule
rules.body: Large areas are catalogue green or index card, nothing else. A third large surface colour breaks the room.

rules.name: The Red Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Red appears only as the single red line on a card head and as stamp or error ink. It is never a button, a badge fill, or decoration.

rules.name: The Brass Is Hardware Rule
rules.body: Brass belongs to things you pull, press or label: primary buttons, tab frames, the drawer holder. It is not used for panels or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Typed Is Filed Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is for the user's data and the filing apparatus (titles, notes, stamps, tabs, counts). Archivo is for the instrument (buttons, inputs, explanatory prose). Don't swap them.

rules.name: The Baseline Rule
rules.body: Any ruled card body uses --line (24px) as its line-height so text sits on the pale-blue rule. Change the variable, not individual line-heights.

rules.name: The Paper-Not-Plastic Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe sheets and metal. No diffuse tinted glows, no card-on-card stacking beyond the peek tabs.

dos: Do keep large surfaces to catalogue green (#34503f) and index card (#fdfdfb), and put all content on cards.
Do set card text in Courier Prime on the 24px rule line, with one red line under the head.
Do build primary controls as bevelled brass (gradient, #6f5518 edge, brass bevel shadow) with dark text.
Do mark every place's coordinate provenance with a stamp, using stamp-red for approximate.
Do switch focus rings to ink on cards and keep Focus Yellow on green.
Do keep entrance motion to the file-in rise and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't use red for anything but the card rule, stamps and error messages.
Don't introduce a third surface colour, a gradient background wash, or glassmorphism.
Don't set card body text in Archivo or button text in Courier; the two voices stay separate.
Don't show a place as a table row; places are cards.
Don't add icons as glyph characters; marks in this system are inline SVG (lock, wordmark, drawer pull).
Don't invent sample metrics or testimonials; sample data is always labelled as such (banner in dashed Focus Yellow).
